hypotheses: Recovery varies with realized target-read abundance, coverage, read length, complexity, or error profile.
Some loss occurs at support-evidence linkage or downstream handoff rather than read generation or assembly.
Generator-to-assembler interactions may explain outcomes not captured by marginal effects.
Near-zero substitution contrasts reproduce across independent synthetic families.
The observed histogram error is associated with one or more read, error, composition, or coverage conditions.
objectives.stage_evidence: Retain full raw logs and last documented stage; graph construction/coverage estimation remain unresolved if tool logs do not identify them.

objectives.hypothesis: Separately namespaced SPAdes and Tadpole runs may differ on identical synthetic inputs.
objectives.interpretation: Descriptive only; does not replace M6 or establish biological performance.

experimental_units.split_seed_and_truth_mapping: Restricted evaluation sidecar; not present in analysis inputs or this public manifest.
experimental_units.truth_and_split_mapping: Restricted evaluation sidecar; unavailable to analysis stages until locked unblinding.

frozen_baseline.generator: Existing M25 synthetic read generator; audit semantics before execution.

controls.role: verify generated target reads and simulator placement ledger
pipeline integrity control, not a biological negative

matrix.comparison_design: One factor at a time plus two prespecified coverage-by-abundance corners; not a full factorial.
matrix.blocked_condition: 1:9 target:background ratio is NOT_RUN until generator audit confirms the ratio can be set and measured exactly.

blocked_factors.blocker: Current adapter does not expose k-mer selection; separately reviewed, version-compatible options and frozen values are required.

blocked_factors.limitation: Low-complexity condition appears in the recovery block; it is not fully crossed with every SPAdes factor.

matrix.family_assignment: All 12 registered family tokens, one matched background-only control per family; target sequence and target-derived reads are absent.
matrix.purpose: Synthetic target-absent specificity control, not a biological negative.

assemblers.version_requirement: Freeze exact version output and executable SHA-256; M35 summary does not pin it.

matrix.family_selection: Eight family tokens total; four development families are for exploratory compatibility checks and four held-out families are reserved for the locked final comparison. Exact family-to-split assignments exist only in the restricted sidecar.
matrix.paired_input_rule: For each family, arm, and repeat, SPAdes and Tadpole receive byte-identical FASTQ inputs. Repeat 1 and repeat 2 use independently simulated reads.
matrix.exploratory_role: Development-family compatibility and output-contract checks only; cannot tune against held-out results.
matrix.held_out_role: Locked final paired comparison after tools, inputs, analysis, and thresholds are frozen.

registered_case_manifest.purpose: Complete preregistered family-condition-repeat-tool assignments; counts are derived by expanding these entries.
registered_case_manifest.analysis_visible_case_ids: Fresh opaque random tokens; never use family, split, truth, factor, condition, or assembler labels in paths, FASTQ headers, stage IDs, or analyst-facing logs.
registered_case_manifest.analysis_visible_header_rule: FASTQ headers contain only the opaque case token and read ordinal; no split, truth, family, condition, or factor labels.
registered_case_manifest.analysis_visible_log_rule: Blinded logs use opaque tokens only; raw tool logs remain restricted and sanitized logs remove paths and factor-revealing command echoes.

restricted_evaluation_sidecar.access: Evaluator only; excluded from generator/assembler/analysis stage inputs and analyst-facing logs.
restricted_evaluation_sidecar.unblinding_point: Only after raw evidence and analysis outputs are hashed, denominator/status validation passes, the design and analysis are frozen, and the independent reviewer authorizes locked unblinding.

planned_totals.cpu_estimate_status: Planning estimate, not measured; execution is blocked unless each attempt can be constrained to one vCPU or the estimate is recalculated.
planned_totals.budget_exhaustion: Stop launching queued attempts at the wall or aggregate slot budget. Preserve in-progress evidence; mark cancelled attempts INTERRUPTED_BUDGET and unstarted attempts NOT_RUN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Do not retry automatically.

analysis.technical_repeats: Repeats use independent read-simulation seeds; summarize within family-condition and never count as independent families.
analysis.paired_comparison: Within each family, arm, and repeat, compare SPAdes and Tadpole on byte-identical reads. Compute paired differences per repeat, summarize repeats within family, then show each of the four family-level differences and their median and range; do not pool repeat-level rows as independent observations or claim inferential power from four families.
analysis.reporting: All n/N, unevaluable, failure, interruption, and NOT_RUN blocker counts.
analysis.held_out_unblinding: Only after locked design, tools, and analyses validate.
analysis.unevaluable_positive_rule: No supported assembly means unevaluable, not a positive or negative detection.

acceptance_gates_for_phase2: Independent scientific review approves design, endpoints, exclusions, uncertainty plan, and budget.
User explicitly authorizes Phase 2 synthetic execution.
Generator semantics, abundance, seed separation, complexity, and placement evidence are audited.
Exact executable versions and hashes are frozen and input/output compatibility is smoke-tested.
Held-out truth and factor labels are absent from analysis-visible inputs and identifiers.
CI validates denominator accounting, distinct failure statuses, evidence hashes, and frozen M6/M8/M31 constraints.
Authorization is scoped to the exact synthetic matrix, commit, tools, and resource limits.

capability_gaps.gap: Confirm abundance, coverage, composition, and placement-ledger semantics; exact 1:9 arm is blocked until verifiable.
Current adapter does not expose k-mer selection; implementation needs separate review.
Freeze exact version output and executable digest.
Create a synthetic-only crosswalk without exposing truth to analysis stages.
No execution workflow is added or enabled in Phase 1.

limitations: M35's three exact-positive controls were unevaluable because none had supported assembly.
M35's 26/28 SPAdes failures do not identify a confirmed causal mechanism.
The small family count and one-factor matrix cannot resolve every interaction.
M35 summary evidence does not record exact SPAdes version.
Synthetic results cannot establish biological sensitivity, specificity, or validated discovery.
